name: ai-gateway-client-LAB
description: OAuth PKCE + Dynamic Client Registration test client for an OAuth-protected MCP gateway (PingOne Agent Privilege by default).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix server & npm run dev --prefix web
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix web && npm start --prefix server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix web
